# Teknomech MEP

> Teknomech MEP is Qatar's certified MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) and Fire Protection contractor, delivering end-to-end solutions for commercial, industrial and government projects across Doha and Qatar.

## Company Information

- **Name**: Teknomech MEP
- **Location**: Office no. 16, First Floor, Building Number 43, Street number 46, Zone 56, Jeera Building, Barwa Commercial Avenue, Doha, Qatar
- **Phone**: +974 3044 3229
- **Email**: info@teknomech.com
- **Website**: https://www.teknomech.com
- **Certifications**: ISO 9001 Certified, NFPA Compliant, fully compliant with Qatar's applicable regulations
- **Emergency**: 24/7 emergency response available

## Services

- **Fire Protection Systems** — Design, supply, installation and commissioning of suppression, sprinkler, alarm and detection systems; fully QCDD compliant
- **HVAC Systems** — Central cooling, VRF/VRV, split units, district cooling integration, ventilation
- **Electrical Systems** — LV/MV power distribution, lighting, earthing, lightning protection
- **Plumbing & Drainage** — Potable water, hot water, sewage and stormwater systems
- **Low Voltage (LV) Systems** — CCTV, access control, structured cabling, BMS, PA systems
- **MEP Maintenance** — Planned preventive maintenance (PPM) contracts, 24/7 emergency callouts
